'''Stephen Smith''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Arizona State Championship]] on 14 April 2001 with troopers, according to Steve Marshall's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2082">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-15-viper-hits-states-phoenix-az-4-14-01d2082/ viper-hits-states-phoenix-az-4-14-01], DeckTech (Steve "BlackViper" Marshall, 15 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-15-viper-hits-states-phoenix-az-4-14-01d2082/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
